title: Felix and the Glasshouse
author: Wren Villalobos
blurb: Mara Iversen, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
